text: THE WEBSITE'S LAST HAND-BUILT BUTTONS ARE GONE, AND THE ESTATE'S COUNT IS ZERO. 53 raw <button> elements across 21 files: the home page's hero arrows, play control and slide dots, the Important Links rail tab and its panel close, the Activity Corner, Offerings and social-platform switches, the organisation filters and the persona arrows; the de-addiction centre locator and its four competing design options, including its filters, its rows, its retry and its pager; the PM-AJAY works map's drill-down trail (now Breadcrumb), its sortable headings, its retry and its state, district and village rows; the organisation announcement band's slide dots, play, dismiss and registration-code tile, matched to the exploration band migrated a day earlier; the schemes catalogue's view switch and category filters; the website data table's sortable headings; and the demo data-mode panel. Two defects found by comparing screenshots rather than by reading: skinning Tabs as slide dots gave every dot a tooltip, because a deliberately hidden label measures as a truncated one, and the card-gallery option's pop-up map painted over its own title, address and close control. Both fixed. With this, npm run check:raw-button reports 0 in app code and 0 in the design system, with 75 controls declared as the component itself.
